TEXT.TEXTVALUE: We require acetic acid, pH paper strip, a standard colour pH chart, dropper and a white tile.
Take a pH paper strip and place it on a white tile.

Take a pH paper strip and place it on a white tile.
Take a small quantity of acetic acid using a dropper.
Pour one drop of acetic acid on the pH paper.
Observe the colour produced on the pH paper. The colour of the pH paper changes to red.
Compare the colour produced on the pH paper with the different colour shades of a standard colour pH chart and note down the pH from the colour chart. The pH of acetic acid is 3.
We require acetic acid, universal indicator, a standard colour pH chart, dropper and a test tube.
Take a small quantity of acetic acid using a dropper and pour it into a test tube.
Take a small quantity of acetic acid using a dropper and pour it into a test tube.
Take a small quantity of universal indicator solution.
Pour a few drops of universal indicator into the test tube containing acetic acid.
Shake the test tube well. The colour of the solution changes to red.
Compare the colour produced in the test tube with the standard colour pH chart and note down the pH from the colour chart. The pH of acetic acid is 3.
